17use crate::{
18    common::{BitMatrix, Result},
19    Exceptions,
20};
21
22use super::{DataMask, FormatInformation, Version, VersionRef};
23
24/**
25 * @author Sean Owen
26 */
27pub struct BitMatrixParser {
28    bitMatrix: BitMatrix,
29    parsedVersion: Option<VersionRef>,
30    parsedFormatInfo: Option<FormatInformation>,
31    mirror: bool,
32}
33
34impl BitMatrixParser {
35    /**
36     * @param bitMatrix {@link BitMatrix} to parse
37     * @throws FormatException if dimension is not >= 21 and 1 mod 4
38     */
39    pub fn new(bit_matrix: BitMatrix) -> Result<Self> {
40        let dimension = bit_matrix.getHeight();
41        if dimension < 21 || (dimension & 0x03) != 1 {
42            Err(Exceptions::format_with(format!(
43                "{dimension} < 21 || ({dimension} % 0x03) != 1"
44            )))
45        } else {
46            Ok(Self {
47                bitMatrix: bit_matrix,
48                parsedVersion: None,
49                parsedFormatInfo: None,
50                mirror: false,
51            })
52        }
53    }
54
55    /**
56     * <p>Reads format information from one of its two locations within the QR Code.</p>
57     *
58     * @return {@link FormatInformation} encapsulating the QR Code's format info
59     * @throws FormatException if both format information locations cannot be parsed as
60     * the valid encoding of format information
61     */
62    pub fn readFormatInformation(&mut self) -> Result<&FormatInformation> {
63        if self.parsedFormatInfo.is_some() {
64            return self.parsedFormatInfo.as_ref().ok_or(Exceptions::PARSE);
65        }
66
67        // Read top-left format info bits
68        let mut formatInfoBits1 = 0;
69        for i in 0..6 {
70            formatInfoBits1 = self.copyBit(i, 8, formatInfoBits1);
71        }
72        // .. and skip a bit in the timing pattern ...
73        formatInfoBits1 = self.copyBit(7, 8, formatInfoBits1);
74        formatInfoBits1 = self.copyBit(8, 8, formatInfoBits1);
75        formatInfoBits1 = self.copyBit(8, 7, formatInfoBits1);
76        // .. and skip a bit in the timing pattern ...
77        for j in (0..=5).rev() {
78            formatInfoBits1 = self.copyBit(8, j, formatInfoBits1);
79        }
80
81        // Read the top-right/bottom-left pattern too
82        let dimension = self.bitMatrix.getHeight();
83        let mut formatInfoBits2 = 0;
84        let jMin = dimension - 7;
85        for j in (jMin..=dimension - 1).rev() {
86            formatInfoBits2 = self.copyBit(8, j, formatInfoBits2);
87        }
88        for i in (dimension - 8)..dimension {
89            formatInfoBits2 = self.copyBit(i, 8, formatInfoBits2);
90        }
91
92        self.parsedFormatInfo =
93            FormatInformation::decodeFormatInformation(formatInfoBits1, formatInfoBits2);
94
95        self.parsedFormatInfo.as_ref().ok_or(Exceptions::FORMAT)
96    }
97
98    /**
99     * <p>Reads version information from one of its two locations within the QR Code.</p>
100     *
101     * @return {@link Version} encapsulating the QR Code's version
102     * @throws FormatException if both version information locations cannot be parsed as
103     * the valid encoding of version information
104     */
105    pub fn readVersion(&mut self) -> Result<VersionRef> {
106        if let Some(pv) = self.parsedVersion {
107            return Ok(pv);
108        }
109
110        let dimension = self.bitMatrix.getHeight();
111
112        let provisionalVersion = (dimension - 17) / 4;
113        if provisionalVersion <= 6 {
114            return Version::getVersionForNumber(provisionalVersion);
115        }
116
117        // Read top-right version info: 3 wide by 6 tall
118        let mut versionBits = 0;
119        let ijMin = dimension - 11;
120        for j in (0..=5).rev() {
121            for i in (ijMin..(dimension - 8)).rev() {
122                versionBits = self.copyBit(i, j, versionBits);
123            }
124        }
125
126        if let Ok(theParsedVersion) = Version::decodeVersionInformation(versionBits) {
127            if theParsedVersion.getDimensionForVersion() == dimension {
128                self.parsedVersion = Some(theParsedVersion);
129                return Ok(theParsedVersion);
130            }
131        }
132
133        // Hmm, failed. Try bottom left: 6 wide by 3 tall
134        versionBits = 0;
135        for i in (0..=5).rev() {
136            for j in (ijMin..(dimension - 5)).rev() {
137                versionBits = self.copyBit(i, j, versionBits);
138            }
139        }
140
141        if let Ok(theParsedVersion) = Version::decodeVersionInformation(versionBits) {
142            if theParsedVersion.getDimensionForVersion() == dimension {
143                self.parsedVersion = Some(theParsedVersion);
144                return Ok(theParsedVersion);
145            }
146        }
147        Err(Exceptions::FORMAT)
148    }
149
150    fn copyBit(&self, i: u32, j: u32, versionBits: u32) -> u32 {
151        let bit = if self.mirror {
152            self.bitMatrix.get(j, i)
153        } else {
154            self.bitMatrix.get(i, j)
155        };
156
157        if bit {
158            (versionBits << 1) | 0x1
159        } else {
160            versionBits << 1
161        }
162    }
163
164    /**
165     * <p>Reads the bits in the {@link BitMatrix} representing the finder pattern in the
166     * correct order in order to reconstruct the codewords bytes contained within the
167     * QR Code.</p>
168     *
169     * @return bytes encoded within the QR Code
170     * @throws FormatException if the exact number of bytes expected is not read
171     */
172    pub fn readCodewords(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
173        let version = self.readVersion()?;
174
175        // Get the data mask for the format used in this QR Code. This will exclude
176        // some bits from reading as we wind through the bit matrix.
177        let dataMask: DataMask = self.readFormatInformation()?.getDataMask().try_into()?;
178        let dimension = self.bitMatrix.getHeight();
179        dataMask.unmaskBitMatrix(&mut self.bitMatrix, dimension);
180
181        let functionPattern = version.buildFunctionPattern()?;
182
183        let mut readingUp = true;
184        let mut result = vec![0u8; version.getTotalCodewords() as usize];
185        let mut resultOffset = 0;
186        let mut currentByte = 0;
187        let mut bitsRead = 0;
188        // Read columns in pairs, from right to left
189        let mut j = dimension as i32 - 1;
190        while j > 0 {
191            if j == 6 {
192                // Skip whole column with vertical alignment pattern;
193                // saves time and makes the other code proceed more cleanly
194                j -= 1;
195            }
196            // Read alternatingly from bottom to top then top to bottom
197            for count in 0..dimension {
198                let i = if readingUp {
199                    dimension - 1 - count
200                } else {
201                    count
202                };
203                for col in 0..2 {
204                    // Ignore bits covered by the function pattern
205                    if !functionPattern.get(j as u32 - col, i) {
206                        // Read a bit
207                        bitsRead += 1;
208                        currentByte <<= 1;
209                        if self.bitMatrix.get(j as u32 - col, i) {
210                            currentByte |= 1;
211                        }
212                        // If we've made a whole byte, save it off
213                        if bitsRead == 8 {
214                            result[resultOffset] = currentByte;
215                            resultOffset += 1;
216                            bitsRead = 0;
217                            currentByte = 0;
218                        }
219                    }
220                }
221            }
222            readingUp ^= true; // readingUp = !readingUp; // switch directions
223
224            j -= 2;
225        }
226
227        if resultOffset != version.getTotalCodewords() as usize {
228            return Err(Exceptions::FORMAT);
229        }
230        Ok(result)
231    }
232
233    /**
234     * Revert the mask removal done while reading the code words. The bit matrix should revert to its original state.
235     */
236    pub fn remask(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
237        if let Some(pfi) = &self.parsedFormatInfo {
238            let dataMask: DataMask = pfi.getDataMask().try_into()?;
239            let dimension = self.bitMatrix.getHeight();
240            dataMask.unmaskBitMatrix(&mut self.bitMatrix, dimension);
241        } else {
242            // We have no format information, and have no data mask
243        }
244        Ok(())
245    }
246
247    /**
248     * Prepare the parser for a mirrored operation.
249     * This flag has effect only on the {@link #readFormatInformation()} and the
250     * {@link #readVersion()}. Before proceeding with {@link #readCodewords()} the
251     * {@link #mirror()} method should be called.
252     *
253     * @param mirror Whether to read version and format information mirrored.
254     */
255    pub fn setMirror(&mut self, mirror: bool) {
256        self.parsedVersion = None;
257        self.parsedFormatInfo = None;
258        self.mirror = mirror;
259    }
260
261    /** Mirror the bit matrix in order to attempt a second reading. */
262    pub fn mirror(&mut self) {
263        for x in 0..self.bitMatrix.getWidth() {
264            for y in (x + 1)..self.bitMatrix.getHeight() {
265                if self.bitMatrix.get(x, y) != self.bitMatrix.get(y, x) {
266                    self.bitMatrix.flip_coords(y, x);
267                    self.bitMatrix.flip_coords(x, y);
268                }
269            }
270        }
271    }
272}
